_about: Gathering (scripts/camp/camp_gather.gd). Trees never die: each choppable scenery tree (models in trees.models) gives wood_per_day wood a day, one per chop, then rests until the next morning; a chop takes chop_s while the tree wobbles (wobble_deg, wobble_s). A player chops within reach_m of a tree's trunk. Forage spots refill each morning: each has an item, a model drawn while it is there, a spot [x, z] in metres and from_day (a day number) it first appears. A stick goes straight onto the camp's wood pile (wood item); others go into the pockets. Grilling uses cook_wood wood from the pile.
